Quick technical checklist for PDF normalization and manifest generation (what I’ll run):

- Convert all source docs to a single flattened PDF per questionnaire: use ghostscript to flatten forms, then convert to PDF/A-2b for long-term preservation. Example command: gs -dPDFA -dBATCH -dNOPAUSE -sDEVICE=pdfwrite -sOutputFile=SIG_filled_flat.pdf input.pdf
- Remove bookmarks/outlines and embedded attachments to avoid portal indexing issues.
- Rasterize problematic annotations only if redaction metadata is not preserved. If redactions exist, ensure they are true (not visual) redactions.
- Normalize fonts and embed where possible; if embedding fails, outline text to prevent rendering differences.
- Generate SHA256 checksums for each file and the combined zip: shasum -a 256 filename > filename.sha256
- Create manifest CSV with columns: evidence_id, filename, sig_question_id, control_family, page_count, checksum_sha256, uploader, notes
- Max file size: split large evidence into logical pieces (logs split by month) and reference them in the manifest rather than appending huge raw logs. For Whistic, use naming convention: REDWOOD_FINTECHCORP_<evidence_id>_<yyyyMMdd>.pdf
- For OneTrust bulk upload, we’ll include the manifest as the parent record and attach child evidence files; field mapping may need manual mapping for the SIG question IDs.

I’ll drop the shell script I used for batch normalization in the shared folder (pdf_normalization_commands.sh). Once Marissa uploads the bundle to our staging bucket I’ll run checksums and produce the final manifest.

Karthik Iyer

Sample rows from the manifest (SIG_manifest_20270414.csv):
"evidence_id,filename,sig_question_id,control_family,page_count,checksum_sha256,uploader,notes"
"EVID-001,SIG_filled_flat_20270414.pdf,SIG-1.1,Access Control,38,3b7f9c...a1e,marissa_cole,flattened questionnaire"
"EVID-002,SOC2-bridge-letter.pdf,SIG-2.3,Security Monitoring,2,5c4d2b...f9c,marissa_cole,SOC 2 bridge + date range included"

Notes and portal specifics observed:
- Whistic accepts the ZIP but indexing is better when files follow the REDWOOD_FINTECHCORP naming scheme.
- Whistic upload UI truncates file descriptions at ~250 chars — put long notes in the manifest.
- OneTrust requires the manifest be attached to the parent record; some fields (control family) require manual mapping post-upload.
- Evidence with PII was redacted and verified; redaction logs are in evidence_redaction_log.txt (included in ZIP).

I uploaded the zip to our staging S3 bucket and shared links in Google Drive for quick access. Karthik — your checksum and final normalization pass are next. Lauren — plz do the final QA and confirm we can push to Whistic.

Marissa Cole
